scenarios.title: Afterlife creates Spirit tokens when the permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Ministrant of Obligation, tapping the Mountain.

variants.label: dies
variants.expected: Ministrant of Obligation (2/1) is dealt 2 damage and dies; its afterlife 2 trigger fires and B gets two 1/1 white and black Spirit creature tokens with flying.

variants.label: survives
variants.delta: B's creature is Syndicate Messenger (2/3) instead of Ministrant of Obligation.
variants.expected: Syndicate Messenger survives with 2 damage marked; its afterlife trigger does not fire and B has no Spirit tokens.

variants.label: bounced
variants.delta: A casts Unsummon (tapping the Island) instead of Shock.
variants.expected: Ministrant of Obligation returns to B's hand and is never put into a graveyard; its afterlife trigger does not fire and B has no Spirit tokens.

scenarios.title: Two instances of afterlife trigger separately
decisions: A casts Afterlife Insurance, tapping two Plains; it resolves and A draws a card.
A casts Shock targeting Orzhov Enforcer (their own creature), tapping the Mountain.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: Orzhov Enforcer (1/2) has afterlife 1 printed and afterlife 1 from Afterlife Insurance; it dies, two afterlife triggers fire and resolve separately, and A gets two 1/1 white and black Spirit tokens with flying.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: A does not cast Afterlife Insurance; A casts only Shock.
variants.expected: Orzhov Enforcer dies and its single afterlife trigger resolves: A gets one Spirit token.
